eastern-scholar.npc: Ah mortal, tell me, would you prefer to have your arms attached to the bottom of your feet, or your legs attached to the palms of your hands?
I wish to gain insight into your wants, so that I may provide enticing relics to your kind.

eastern-scholar.player: Well honestly, neither option is appealing. I like my limbs where they are.

eastern-scholar.npc: Prudish as expected. I must return to my work.

western-scholar.npc: Fool! Losing my focus due to your interruption! Leave now or I will break you.

western-scholar.player: Fine. No need to be rude about it.
